messages.content:
You are a course content creator. Generate presentation slides based on this course outline.

COURSE CONTEXT:
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that focuses on building systems that can learn from data. Key concepts include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning. Neural networks are a fundamental building block, and gradient descent is the primary optimization algorithm used.

OUTLINE:
[
  {
    "id": "node_1",
    "title": "Introduction to Machine Learning",
    "description": "Comprehensive overview of machine learning as a core artificial intelligence discipline. Explore the fundamental concepts and significance of learning systems.",
    "level": 1,
    "order": 0,
    "estimatedDuration": 30,
    "children": [
      {
        "id": "node_1_1",
        "title": "What is Machine Learning?",
        "description": "Define machine learning and its relationship to artificial intelligence. Explain how systems learn from data and adapt their performance.",
        "level": 2,
        "order": 0,
        "estimatedDuration": 10,
        "children": [
          {
            "id": "node_1_1_1",
            "title": "Types of Machine Learning",
            "description": "Explore supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning paradigms. Understand the key differences and use cases.",
            "level": 3,
            "order": 0,
            "estimatedDuration": 5
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
]

ACCESSIBILITY MODE: visual

VISUAL LEARNERS prefer:
- Diagrams, charts, and infographics
- Color-coded information
- Mind maps and visual hierarchies
- Images and illustrations
- Spatial organization of content

Generate slides that:
1. Cover each topic in the outline
2. Use appropriate content types for visual learners
3. Include speaker notes for instructors
4. Have clear, engaging titles

For each slide, provide:
- title: Clear slide title
- content: Array of content blocks with type and content
- speakerNotes: Teaching notes for the instructor
- layout: Appropriate layout (title, content, two-column, diagram)
- outlineNodeId: Reference to outline node

Content types available:
- heading: Main headings
- text: Paragraphs
- bullet-points: Lists (content as array)
- diagram: Mermaid diagram code
- quote: Important quotes
- code: Code examples

Return ONLY valid JSON as an array of slides:
[
  {
    "title": "Introduction to Topic",
    "content": [
      {
        "type": "heading",
        "content": "Welcome"
      },
      {
        "type": "text",
        "content": "This course covers..."
      },
      {
        "type": "bullet-points",
        "content": ["Point 1", "Point 2", "Point 3"]
      }
    ],
    "speakerNotes": "Start with a warm welcome. Ask students about their background.",
    "layout": "title",
    "outlineNodeId": "node_1"
  }
]
